title: Closed direct image preserves flat pro-etale module sheaves
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, X a locally Noetherian scheme and i:Z→X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], if M is a flat A-module sheaf (flatness of [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]), then i_* M is flat. Flat means tensoring with the object preserves finite limits.

source.place: Signed total tensor and K-flat derivation of the supported exterior product

proof.text: Use exact monoidal restriction to the closed subscheme and its open complement. Their jointly conservative pair reflects exactness, by the exactFunctor_of_iso criterion, applied to tensorLeft and its monoidal restriction isomorphisms.

For i_* M the restriction to Z is isomorphic to M by the closed-immersion counit. Its restriction to the complementary open is zero. Both are flat, so the preceding exactness criterion proves flatness of i_* M. A locally Noetherian scheme makes the complementary open quasi-compact.

theorem lowerStar_preserves_flat_closed
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {Z X : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsLocallyNoetherian X]
    (M : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (hM : ObjectProperty.flat M) :
    ObjectProperty.flat ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj M)
